ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider (UNC3944/Octo Tempest) RMM tool stacking on a single host
ucs.description: Detects two or more distinct remote-management tools from Scattered Spider's documented toolkit (AnyDesk, Splashtop, ScreenConnect, TeamViewer, Pulseway, Level.io, Atera, Action1, ngrok, Fleetdeck, TacticalRMM, Rsocx, ScreenMeet, Tailscale) installed or executed on the same endpoint within 24 hours. UNC3944 characteristically layers multiple RMM agents post-help-desk-impersonation for redundant access if one is removed (Mandiant, CISA AA23-320A, Microsoft Octo Tempest reporting).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as firstSeen max(_time) as lastSeen values(Processes.process) as commandlines values(Processes.process_name) as tools dc(Processes.process_name) as toolCount from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","splashtop.exe","SRServer.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe","teamviewer.exe","TeamViewer_Service.exe","pulseway.exe","PCMonitorSrv.exe","level.exe","AteraAgent.exe","Action1_agent.exe","ngrok.exe","rsocx.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","meshagent.exe","ScreenMeet.exe","tailscaled.exe","rustdesk.exe","zaservice.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*anydesk*","*splashtop*","*screenconnect*","*connectwisecontrol*","*teamviewer*","*pulseway*","*level.io*","*ateraagent*","*action1*","* ngrok *","*rsocx*","*fleetdeck*","*tacticalrmm*","*meshcentral*","*screenmeet*","*rustdesk*","*zoho assist*","*tailscale*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | stats min(firstSeen) as firstSeen max(lastSeen) as lastSeen values(commandlines) as commandlines values(process_name) as tools dc(process_name) as toolCount by dest user | where toolCount >= 2 AND user!="SYSTEM" AND NOT match(user,"\\$$") | convert ctime(firstSeen) ctime(lastSeen) | sort - firstSeen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let RMMTokens = dynamic(["anydesk","splashtop","screenconnect","connectwisecontrol","teamviewer","pulseway","pcmonitorsrv","level.io","ateraagent","action1","ngrok","rsocx","fleetdeck","tacticalrmm","meshagent","meshcentral","screenmeet","tailscale","rustdesk","zoho assist","zaservice"]);
let ProcHits = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | where FileName has_any (RMMTokens) or FolderPath has_any (RMMTokens) or ProcessCommandLine has_any (RMMTokens)
    | extend ToolKey = tolower(extract(@"(anydesk|splashtop|screenconnect|connectwisecontrol|teamviewer|pulseway|level\.io|ateraagent|action1|ngrok|rsocx|fleetdeck|tacticalrmm|meshagent|meshcentral|screenmeet|tailscale|rustdesk|zoho assist|zaservice)", 1, strcat(FileName," ",FolderPath," ",ProcessCommandLine)));
let FileHits = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName has_any (RMMTokens) or FolderPath has_any (RMMTokens)
    | extend ToolKey = tolower(extract(@"(anydesk|splashtop|screenconnect|connectwisecontrol|teamviewer|pulseway|level\.io|ateraagent|action1|ngrok|rsocx|fleetdeck|tacticalrmm|meshagent|meshcentral|screenmeet|tailscale|rustdesk|zoho assist|zaservice)", 1, strcat(FileName," ",FolderPath)))
    | extend AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
union ProcHits, FileHits
| where isnotempty(ToolKey)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctTools = dcount(ToolKey),
            Tools = make_set(ToolKey, 20),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            SamplePaths = make_set(FolderPath, 10)
            by DeviceName, AccountName
| where DistinctTools >= 2   // 2+ RMMs on one host within 24h = Scattered Spider redundancy signature
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let RMMTokens = dynamic(["anydesk","splashtop","screenconnect","connectwisecontrol","teamviewer","pulseway","pcmonitorsrv","level.io","ateraagent","action1","ngrok","rsocx","fleetdeck","tacticalrmm","meshagent","meshcentral","screenmeet","tailscale","rustdesk","zoho assist","zaservice"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$" and ActorUsername !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where TargetProcessName has_any (RMMTokens) or ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (RMMTokens) or TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (RMMTokens)
| extend ToolKey = tolower(extract(@"(anydesk|splashtop|screenconnect|connectwisecontrol|teamviewer|pulseway|level\.io|ateraagent|action1|ngrok|rsocx|fleetdeck|tacticalrmm|meshagent|meshcentral|screenmeet|tailscale|rustdesk|zoho assist|zaservice)", 1, strcat(TargetProcessName," ",TargetProcessCommandLine)))
| where isnotempty(ToolKey)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctTools = dcount(ToolKey), Tools = make_set(ToolKey, 20),
            SampleCmds = make_set(TargetProcessCommandLine, 10)
            by DvcHostname, ActorUsername
| where DistinctTools >= 2   // 2+ distinct RMMs in 24h on same host
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Scattered Spider Remote Management Tool Execution
id: 8a6f4b21-7c2d-4b6e-9f3e-1a8e2d4c9b07
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of remote management tools heavily abused by Scattered Spider (UNC3944 / Octo Tempest / Muddled Libra) for redundant interactive access after help-desk-impersonation password resets.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-320a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/10/25/octo-tempest-crosses-boundaries-to-facilitate-extortion-encryption-and-destruction/
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/06/13
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\anydesk.exe'
      - '\splashtop.exe'
      - '\SRServer.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
      - '\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe'
      - '\TeamViewer.exe'
      - '\TeamViewer_Service.exe'
      - '\Pulseway.exe'
      - '\PCMonitorSrv.exe'
      - '\level.exe'
      - '\AteraAgent.exe'
      - '\Action1_agent.exe'
      - '\ngrok.exe'
      - '\rsocx.exe'
      - '\fleetdeck_agent.exe'
      - '\tacticalrmm.exe'
      - '\MeshAgent.exe'
      - '\ScreenMeet.exe'
      - '\tailscaled.exe'
      - '\rustdesk.exe'
  condition: selection_image
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned IT remote-support tool (verify only one approved RMM per host; multi-RMM stacking is the actor signature)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1219.002
  - attack.g1015
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:(1 OR 4688)) @Image:(*\anydesk.exe OR *\AnyDesk.exe OR *\splashtop.exe OR *\Splashtop.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe OR *\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe OR *\teamviewer.exe OR *\TeamViewer.exe OR *\TeamViewer_Service.exe OR *\pulseway.exe OR *\Pulseway.exe OR *\PCMonitorSrv.exe OR *\level.exe OR *\AteraAgent.exe OR *\Action1_agent.exe OR *\ngrok.exe OR *\NGROK.exe OR *\rsocx.exe OR *\fleetdeck_agent.exe OR *\tacticalrmm.exe OR *\MeshAgent.exe OR *\meshagent.exe OR *\ScreenMeet.exe OR *\tailscaled.exe OR *\rustdesk.exe) -@User:(*SYSTEM* OR *NETWORK\ SERVICE* OR *LOCAL\ SERVICE*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(anydesk|splashtop|srserver|screenconnect\.(clientservice|windowsclient)|connectwisecontrol\.client|teamviewer(_service)?|pulseway|pcmonitorsrv|level|ateraagent|action1_agent|ngrok|rsocx|fleetdeck_agent|tacticalrmm|meshagent|screenmeet|tailscaled|rustdesk|zaservice)\.exe$/i
| UserName!=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| ToolKey := lower(regex("(?i)(anydesk|splashtop|screenconnect|connectwisecontrol|teamviewer|pulseway|pcmonitorsrv|level|ateraagent|action1|ngrok|rsocx|fleetdeck|tacticalrmm|meshagent|screenmeet|tailscaled|rustdesk)", field=ImageFileName, strict=false))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(field=ToolKey, distinct=true, as=DistinctTools), collect([ToolKey, CommandLine], multival=true), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| DistinctTools >= 2
| sort(FirstSeen, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider help-desk impersonation: password/MFA reset followed by privileged role grant
ucs.description: Detects the chained-action signature of Octo Tempest / UNC3944 social-engineered help-desk takeover: a single actor principal (the impersonated help-desk admin or the freshly-compromised IT identity) performs a user-password reset or MFA-method change AND adds a directory role / privileged app-role assignment to a Tier-0 group within a 30-minute window. This is the documented Entra ID kill-chain step the group uses before pivoting to Okta super-admin, AzureHound enumeration, and VM creation.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as firstSeen max(_time) as lastSeen values(All_Changes.command) as ops values(All_Changes.object) as targets dc(All_Changes.command) as opTypes from datamodel=Change.All_Changes where All_Changes.vendor_product IN ("Azure Active Directory","Microsoft Entra ID","Okta") AND All_Changes.command IN ("Reset user password","Reset password (by admin)","Update user","Update StsRefreshTokenValidFrom Timestamp","Disable Strong Authentication","Update authentication method","user.mfa.factor.reset_all","user.account.reset_password","Add member to role","Add eligible member to role","Add app role assignment to service principal","Add owner to application","group.user_membership.add","user.account.privilege.grant") by All_Changes.user All_Changes.src _time span=30m | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | where opTypes>=2 AND (match(mvjoin(ops,","),"(?i)(password|mfa|authentication method|StsRefresh)") AND match(mvjoin(ops,","),"(?i)(add member to role|app role assignment|add owner|privilege.grant|user_membership.add)")) | rename user as actor, src as actor_ip | convert ctime(firstSeen) ctime(lastSeen) | sort - firstSeen
ucs.kql:
let Window = 30m;
let CredOps = dynamic(["Reset user password.","Reset password (by admin).","Update user.","Update StsRefreshTokenValidFrom Timestamp.","Disable Strong Authentication.","Update authentication method.","Set force change user password."]);
let PrivOps = dynamic(["Add member to role.","Add eligible member to role.","Add app role assignment to service principal.","Add owner to application.","Add owner to service principal.","Consent to application."]);
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where Application in ("Microsoft Azure Active Directory","Office 365")
| where ActionType in (CredOps) or ActionType in (PrivOps)
| extend Target = tostring(ActivityObjects[0].Name),
         OpClass = case(ActionType in (CredOps), "credreset", ActionType in (PrivOps), "privgrant", "other")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            CredResets = countif(OpClass=="credreset"),
            PrivGrants = countif(OpClass=="privgrant"),
            Operations = make_set(ActionType, 20),
            Targets = make_set(Target, 20),
            CountryCodes = make_set(CountryCode, 5)
            by AccountObjectId, AccountDisplayName, IPAddress, bin(Timestamp, Window)
| where CredResets >= 1 and PrivGrants >= 1   // help-desk reset + privilege grant by same actor in 30m
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Window = 30m;
let CredOps = dynamic(["Reset user password","Reset password (by admin)","Update user","Update StsRefreshTokenValidFrom Timestamp","Disable Strong Authentication","Update authentication method","Set force change user password"]);
let PrivOps = dynamic(["Add member to role","Add eligible member to role","Add app role assignment to service principal","Add owner to application","Add owner to service principal","Consent to application"]);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Category in ("UserManagement","RoleManagement","ApplicationManagement","AuthenticationMethod")
| where OperationName in (CredOps) or OperationName in (PrivOps)
| extend Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
         ActorIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress),
         ActorAppId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.appId),
         Target = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName),
         OpClass = case(OperationName in (CredOps), "credreset", OperationName in (PrivOps), "privgrant", "other")
| where isnotempty(Actor) or isnotempty(ActorAppId)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            CredResets = countif(OpClass=="credreset"),
            PrivGrants = countif(OpClass=="privgrant"),
            Operations = make_set(OperationName, 20),
            Targets = make_set(Target, 20)
            by Actor, ActorIP, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
| where CredResets >= 1 and PrivGrants >= 1
| join kind=leftouter (
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | summarize ActorCountries = make_set(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), 5),
                ActorUAs = make_set(UserAgent, 5)
                by UserPrincipalName
  ) on $left.Actor == $right.UserPrincipalName
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory (@evt.name:("Reset user password" OR "Reset password (by admin)" OR "Update user" OR "Update StsRefreshTokenValidFrom Timestamp" OR "Disable Strong Authentication" OR "Update authentication method" OR "Add member to role" OR "Add eligible member to role" OR "Add app role assignment to service principal" OR "Add owner to application" OR "Consent to application")) @properties.result:success -@usr.email:(*svc-* OR *sync_* OR *AAD_*)
ucs.rationale: Scattered Spider's signature isn't any single Entra action — every help desk does password resets, every IAM admin grants roles. The signature is one actor performing the credential-recovery action AND the privilege-grant action inside a tight window, because they impersonate the help desk on a phone call, reset the target's MFA, then immediately use the same admin session to backdoor that account
